fields.name: Preparation Time
fields.description: Estimated time required to prepare the recipe.

fields.name: Vegan
fields.description: Indicates whether the recipe contains animal-derived ingredients.

fields.name: Vegetarian
fields.description: Indicates whether the recipe contains meat or fish, but may include animal by-products.

fields.name: Cooking Method
fields.description: Technique used to cook the recipe (e.g., baking, frying).

fields.name: Difficulty
fields.description: Indicates how easy or challenging the recipe is to make.

fields.name: Lactose Free
fields.description: Does not contain lactose or dairy-based ingredients.

fields.name: Gluten Free
fields.description: Made without gluten-containing ingredients.

fields.name: Cost
fields.description: Estimated expense to prepare the recipe.

fields.name: Very Fast
fields.description: Preparation time estimated below 10 minutes.

fields.name: Fast
fields.description: Preparation time estimated between 10 and 20 minutes.

fields.name: Medium
fields.description: Preparation time estimated between 20 and 40 minutes.

fields.name: Slow
fields.description: Preparation time estimated between 40 and 90 minutes.

fields.name: Very Slow
fields.description: Preparation time estimated over 90 minutes.

fields.name: Yes
fields.description: Does not contain animal-derived ingredients.

fields.name: No
fields.description: Contains animal-derived ingredients.

fields.name: Yes
fields.description: Does not contain meat or fish, but may include animal by-products.

fields.name: No
fields.description: Contains meat or fish.

fields.name: Baked
fields.description: Cooked in an oven, typically resulting in a dry heat preparation.

fields.name: Boiled
fields.description: Cooked in boiling water or another hot liquid.

fields.name: Broil
fields.description: Exposed to direct heat, usually from above, in an oven broiler.

fields.name: Fried
fields.description: Cooked in hot oil or fat, resulting in a crispy texture.

fields.name: Grilled
fields.description: Cooked over an open flame or hot surface, often with grill marks.

fields.name: Roasted
fields.description: Cooked in an oven at high temperatures, usually until browned or caramelized.

fields.name: Slow Cooking
fields.description: Cooked at low temperatures over a long period, often in a slow cooker.

fields.name: Steamed
fields.description: Cooked with steam, preserving moisture and nutrients.

fields.name: Pressure Cooked
fields.description: Cooked using a pressure cooker to reduce time while retaining flavor.

fields.name: Microwaved
fields.description: Cooked in a microwave oven using electromagnetic radiation.

fields.name: Sous Vide
fields.description: Cooked slowly in a water bath at a precise low temperature in vacuum-sealed bags.

fields.name: Toasted
fields.description: Cooked using dry heat to make the surface crisp or brown, often in a toaster.

fields.name: Blended
fields.description: Processed into a smooth mixture using a blender or food processor.

fields.name: Raw
fields.description: Not cooked; ingredients are used in their natural, uncooked state.

fields.name: Other
fields.description: Prepared using a method that does not fall into any of the main cooking techniques listed.

fields.name: Easy
fields.description: Simple steps, minimal ingredients, quick to prepare.

fields.name: Medium
fields.description: Moderate preparation time and skill required.

fields.name: Hard
fields.description: Advanced skills or techniques needed for preparation.

fields.name: Yes
fields.description: Does not contain lactose or dairy-derived ingredients.

fields.name: No
fields.description: Contains lactose or dairy-derived ingredients.

fields.name: Yes
fields.description: Does not contain gluten or gluten-containing ingredients.

fields.name: No
fields.description: Contains gluten or ingredients derived from wheat, barley, or rye.

fields.name: Very Cheap
fields.description: Extremely low cost per serving; ideal for tight budgets.

fields.name: Cheap
fields.description: Low cost per serving; affordable ingredients.

fields.name: Medium
fields.description: Moderate cost per serving; balanced between affordability and quality.

fields.name: Expensive
fields.description: High cost per serving; includes premium or imported ingredients.

fields.name: Rich
fields.description: Very high-end ingredients or luxury recipe; suited for special occasions.
